DEFORM Premier 2025 from Scientific Forming Technologies Corporation

::: {.callout-note}
*Finite element modeling* is a method for simulating the deformation of materials under various loading conditions, used for optimizing forming processes and predicting material behavior.
:::

Modules:

* DEFORM-3D: A general-purpose 3D finite element solver for simulating a wide range of forming processes, including forging, extrusion, and sheet metal forming.
* DEFORM-2D: A 2D finite element solver for simulating axisymmetric forming processes, such as deep drawing and tube hydroforming.
